clue.text: Business meeting overwhelmed by papers — an embarrassing situation

indicators.note: the meeting is swamped, so it sits inside the word for papers

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper
AGM is the annual general meeting of a company

explanation.surface: A dull company meeting buried under paperwork becomes an awkward ordeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'papers' looks like documents for the meeting, but QUIRE is a paper-trade unit; 'overwhelmed by' places the meeting inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bog you cannot escape is the figurative image for a predicament, a mess hard to get out of.

clue.text: Measure love in a book

parts.note: a quart is a measure of liquid, two pints
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A reader gauges the affection described in a novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarto is a book size, made from sheets folded twice, and hence a book of that format.

clue.text: Citadel needs a year's produce to store up

parts.note: the crop is a season's harvest

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to silo grain is to store it in a tower

explanation.surface: A fortress needs to lay in a whole year's harvest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses SILO to OLIS at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An acropolis is the fortified hilltop of an ancient Greek city, most famously at Athens.

clue.text: Washing blue's about a penny

indicators.note: the gloomy word goes around the coin, holding it within

parts.note: blue means low-spirited, so being blue is moping
p is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: A sad laundry worker frets over a penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue's about' reads as 'moping is around'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleaning a floor with a wet sponge on a stick is a kind of washing.

clue.text: Managed, say, climbing mountains

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the letters go upwards, reversed

parts.note: eg, for example, means say

explanation.surface: An expedition coped well, so to speak, scaling peaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns EG into GE.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is a chain or line of peaks, such as the Rockies.

clue.text: Write hurriedly, using somewhat abbreviated stroke

indicators.note: the word somewhat is cut short, down to its opening letter

parts.note: the crawl is a swimming stroke

explanation.surface: Someone dashes off a note in clipped shorthand strokes of the pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stroke' looks like a pen stroke, but it is the swimming stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: To scribble untidily in haste is exactly what a careless hand does with a pen.

clue.text: Game that, to some, sounds raucous

indicators.note: sounds says the answer is heard as a different word

parts.note: raucous means hoarse and harsh, croaky

explanation.surface: A lawn game makes a harsh racket, to some ears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to some' hedges the homophone, which depends on accent.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawn game in which mallets drive balls through hoops.

clue.text: American meets Egyptian king, a muslim ruler

parts.note: E is an abbreviation for Egyptian
ER is a royal cipher, here Edward Rex, rex being Latin for king

explanation.surface: A US envoy meets a pharaoh and an Islamic leader.
explanation.definitionFit: An ameer, or emir, is a Muslim prince or commander.

clue.text: Contributed fifty-one pounds towards an unknown daffodil

parts.note: to lend something is to contribute it
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
I is the Roman numeral for one
L is short for libra, the pound
in algebra y is an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: A donor gave fifty-one pounds towards a mysterious flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lent lily is a wild daffodil, flowering around Lent.

clue.text: One pitch is prepared, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the letters are made ready in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A cricket groundsman gets a wicket ready, judging by ear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges ONE PITCH; 'pitch' suggests cricket or tone.
explanation.definitionFit: Phonetic spelling represents words according to how they are spoken.

clue.text: Trace the ebb-tide

definitions.meaning: cryptically, when the tide goes out the sea level falls, literally lowering the sea

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny quantity set against a vast whole, and punningly the falling of the sea at low water.

clue.text: Beef when deposit goes astray

indicators.note: letters that wander off course end up in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone frets that a payment for meat has gone missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes astray' rearranges the letters of DEPOSIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Topside is a lean cut from the upper part of a leg of cattle, sold as a roasting joint.

clue.text: Non-belligerent ultimately short of nerve, on the outside

indicators.note: the nerve word wraps around the final letter, standing outside it

parts.note: neural means relating to the nerves

indicators.note: ultimately points to the closing letter of the word short

explanation.surface: A peace-loving person, at the end of the day, lacks the nerve to stand outside the fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes T from 'short'; 'on the outside' has NEURAL around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A country that takes no side in a war is not fighting, so it is not belligerent.

clue.text: Mark the bombast — it's outrageous

parts.note: to flag something is to mark it out for attention
a rant is bombastic, ranting speech

explanation.surface: A critic notes a speaker's pomposity and calls it scandalous.
explanation.definitionFit: Something glaringly offensive and shocking is flagrant, conspicuously bad.

clue.text: Killer, when with special force, is sent up north

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
the SAS is the British Army's Special Air Service

indicators.note: in a down clue, sent up means the word is read upwards

explanation.surface: A murderer, accompanied by commandos, is despatched northwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent up' turns IS into SI.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired murderer who kills a public figure is an assassin.

clue.text: Being partly blotto, we lost the rubber

indicators.note: only part of the run of words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Drunk at the bridge table, we lost the deciding set of games.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' points to letters inside 'blotto, we lost'. 'rubber' looks like bridge or whist, but it is a thing for rubbing yourself dry.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth used to rub yourself dry after a bath is a rubber in the literal sense.

clue.text: Fats put round baby food as decoration

indicators.note: the musician's name is placed around the baby food

parts.note: Fats Waller was the American jazz pianist
pap is soft mushy food for infants

explanation.surface: Fat is smeared round the infant's meal as ornament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fats' looks like plural lard, but it is jazz pianist Fats Waller.
explanation.definitionFit: Patterned paper pasted on walls is a form of interior decoration.

clue.text: Beetle, a survivor from the past

definitions.meaning: to beetle is to project or overhang
a relic or holdover from an earlier time

explanation.definitionFit: A verb meaning to jut out over, and a relic that lingers from earlier days.

clue.text: One who told tales about river flowing to the ocean

indicators.note: about signals that the whole run of letters is turned round

parts.note: the Po is the great river of northern Italy
the sea is another word for the ocean

explanation.surface: A storyteller recounts tales of a river running to the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the whole charade round, not just the river; the Po does indeed flow to the Adriatic.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek fabulist is famed for animal stories with a moral.

clue.text: I am 'wearing imitation jewelry for fun …

indicators.note: the fake gem word is worn around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: paste is glass used for fake gems
contracted, I am becomes I'm

explanation.surface: Someone admits to wearing costume jewellery just for amusement.
explanation.walkthrough: PASTE is the British spelling's 'jewellery' word too; 'wearing' means the paste encloses the contraction.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobby or diversion engaged in for pleasure.

clue.text: Friendly sort of transport

definitions.meaning: an open carriage, or a tricycle, with seats side by side

explanation.definitionFit: Companionable in manner, and also an old carriage or tandem tricycle with side-by-side seating.

clue.text: … it's the province of an idiot

parts.note: a twerp is a silly person

explanation.surface: Following on, such frivolity is the domain of a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to 19 down for the surface only.
explanation.definitionFit: A province of Belgium, named after its chief city and port.

clue.text: Viewers —— all but one — upset by turn

indicators.note: the remaining letters are overturned into a new order
all of the word is kept except for one letter

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Television viewers, bar one, are upset by a plot twist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all but one' drops I from VIEWERS to leave VEWERS, which 'upset' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To swerve is to veer suddenly, a sharp change of direction.

clue.text: One's heredity put first in a book

indicators.note: the heredity word is placed ahead of the other piece

parts.note: genes are the units of heredity
one is I, and the apostrophe s stands for is, giving I plus S

explanation.surface: Someone claims their ancestry gives them priority in a written work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's' is read as 'one is': I + S.
explanation.definitionFit: The first book of the Old Testament, which opens the Bible.

clue.text: Tongue part of the head? That's about right

indicators.note: the facial feature goes around the single letter

parts.note: the nose is a part of the head

explanation.surface: Is the tongue part of the head? Someone agrees that's correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tongue' looks like the organ in the mouth, but it is a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Norse was the language of medieval Scandinavia, and a tongue is a language.

clue.text: Show one's hand —- it's a breeze

definitions.meaning: cryptically, the hand of a cat, which is its paw
a ... is a light breeze that ruffles calm water

explanation.definitionFit: A feline's foot shown as its hand, and also a sailor's term for a slight ripple of wind.

clue.text: Plants leader of claque before start of play

indicators.note: the first letter comes before the other piece
the opening letter of claque is taken

parts.note: Act I is the first act, the start of a play

explanation.surface: The head of a paid applause group arrives before curtain-up.
explanation.walkthrough: A claque is a group hired to applaud.
explanation.definitionFit: Succulents of desert regions, spiny cacti are plants.

clue.text: Woodbine receiving repair if broken

indicators.note: breaking up the words leaves their letters free to be reassembled

explanation.surface: A climbing plant or a damaged cigarette is getting mended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if broken' rearranges RECEIVING + REPAIR, fifteen letters. Woodbine is also a British cigarette brand, which colours the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: In America woodbine is the name of this climbing vine whose leaves turn scarlet in autumn.

clue.text: Joint may be worn out

definitions.meaning: a ... jacket is a thick double-breasted coat worn outdoors

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a rolled cannabis cigarette, and a heavy sailor's jacket worn out of doors.

clue.text: Broadcast unmasking red spies

indicators.note: the spies, unmasked, are exposed and scattered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Agents for the communists are exposed on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unmasking' rearranges RED + SPIES.
explanation.definitionFit: To scatter seed far and wide is to broadcast it, spreading it about.
